title: Potential Games on Unimodular Random Graphs
summary: We study potential games on unimodular random graphs of bounded degree, where players interact through the underlying network. Using the unimodular measure, we define a well-posed global potential that captures both finite- and infinite-player games. A key observation is that the mass-transport principle identifies the first variation of this potential with the first-order condition of a representative (root) player.
